name: GitHub Copilot Chat RTL Support
summary: 可从 Open VSX 安装。发布者列出的宿主包括 VS Code、Cursor 和 Antigravity。使用 ⇄ 按钮可将 GitHub Copilot Chat 消息切换为从右到左、右对齐的排版，方便阅读希伯来语、阿拉伯语或波斯语。代码块和其余界面仍保持从左到右。https://open-vsx.org/extension/yechielby/copilot-chat-rtl

Install from Open VSX. The publisher lists VS Code, Cursor, and Antigravity as supported hosts. Use the ⇄ toggle to right-align GitHub Copilot Chat messages for Hebrew, Arabic, or Persian. Code blocks and the surrounding interface stay left-to-right. https://open-vsx.org/extension/yechielby/copilot-chat-rtl
